svg.title: Råvan Talani — About & Skills
svg.desc: Råvan Talani. Founding Engineer · Marseille. Founding Engineer at Maesn, building a Unified API connecting 25+ accounting and ERP systems. M.Sc. in Sociotechnical Systems Engineering from Uppsala University. My background spans full-stack development and machine learning. These days, I'm exploring AI and agentic engineering — and always happy to swap ideas about what we're building. Skills: Programming: TypeScript · JavaScript · Python · Java; Web Development: HTML · CSS · React · Vue · Node.js · Next.js · FastAPI; Databases: MongoDB · SQL · PostgreSQL · ChromaDB · Redis · Prisma; Data Science: Pandas · NumPy · R · MATLAB · SciPy · Excel; ML / AI: TensorFlow · PyTorch · LangChain · Keras · Scikit-learn · MCP; Cloud & DevOps: Azure · AWS · Docker · Git. Spoken languages: Swedish: Fluent; English: Fluent; Kurdish: Fluent; French: Intermediate; German: Elementary. Scroll down for projects and experiments, or visit my website for a deeper look into my life.
